description: mod-batch-print configuration template. Reference baseline: Bugfest with 3 standalone tenants and 11 consortia tenants. Memory, JVM limits and replica count match the published Trillium (R1 2026) module configuration table: https://folio-org.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/REL/pages/1034125338. A complete Bugfest baseline for this module's environment variables, CPU allocation, Kong timeouts and sidecar settings could not be found; these values remain unverified against Bugfest. CPU uses the implementation guide's fallback; database port and pool size use ModuleDescriptor-template.json defaults. Environment-specific database settings must be supplied at deployment. JAVA_OPTIONS uses the published Bugfest JVM limits instead of the descriptor's percentage-based heap setting. Empty sidecar arrays satisfy the local schema without prescribing unverified sidecar defaults.

resources.name: cpu
resources.description: CPU units; implementation guide fallback, not verified against Bugfest.

resources.name: memory
resources.description: Container memory hard limit in MiB from the Trillium Bugfest baseline.

resources.name: memoryReservation
resources.description: Container memory reservation in MiB from the Trillium Bugfest baseline.

java.name: xmx
java.description: Maximum Java heap size from the Trillium Bugfest baseline.

java.name: MaxMetaspaceSize
java.description: Maximum Java metaspace size from the Trillium Bugfest baseline.

deployment.description: Two instances match the Trillium Bugfest baseline; the gateway schedules batch creation through the _timer interface, so avoid concurrent batch-creation requests for the same tenant.

kong.description: General gateway timeout defaults from the implementation guide; not verified against Bugfest, so adjust for measured PDF processing and retrieval times.

EnvVars.name: JAVA_OPTIONS
EnvVars.description: JVM options matching the published Bugfest heap and metaspace limits; adjust together with the container memory limit and java entries.

EnvVars.name: DB_HOST
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL server hostname supplied for the deployment.

EnvVars.name: DB_PORT
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL server port; change when using a nonstandard database port.

EnvVars.name: DB_USERNAME
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL account supplied for the deployment with access to the module's tenant schemas.

EnvVars.name: DB_PASSWORD
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL account password supplied securely at deployment.

EnvVars.name: DB_DATABASE
EnvVars.description: PostgreSQL database containing the module's tenant schemas, supplied for the deployment.

EnvVars.name: DB_MAXPOOLSIZE
EnvVars.description: Maximum connections per database pool; descriptor default, to be tuned against database capacity and tenant load.
